objects.placementNote: South edge of Commonlight Square, facing the fountain

hotspots.label: Inspect the Old Dock Mark
hotspots.message: A broken-circle hammer is worn into the stone. The Dockmaster says it has outlasted every storm. For a moment, the river feels warm.

hotspots.label: The Old Swing
hotspots.message: A little rope swing creaks in the breeze. Someone has tucked a flower into the knot. Toma says every child in town has taken a turn.

hotspots.label: Look Across Whisperwind
hotspots.message: The market bells drift up the stone steps. Far below, the river catches the sun. This is a good place to come when you need a quiet moment.

hotspots.label: Read the square inscription
hotspots.message: One stone, one welcome. After the spring flood, each household brought a stone for this square. There is still room for yours.

hotspots.label: Read the garden letter
hotspots.message: We planted these trees when the river took our first garden. If you are beginning again, take an apple and stay awhile.

hotspots.label: Look over Whisperwind
hotspots.message: Lanterns follow the river below. These high terraces sheltered the families who rebuilt the ferry landing. Somewhere a supper bell rings.

hotspots.label: Old lakeside mansion
hotspots.message: The door is boarded shut. A faded notice asks visitors to leave the house undisturbed until its missing records are recovered. A light flickers in the attic.

hotspots.label: Orchard Lake shore
hotspots.message: Small fish flicker among the reeds. This quiet shore will become a fishing spot; for now, River Tackle can guide you to the working fishing dock.

npcs.name: Mira
npcs.label: Talk to Mira
npcs.message: Mara says a town begins with a warm table. I say it begins with someone carrying the bread. Meet Toma at the Pet Center and our Dockmaster, then choose a home. We have room for another neighbor.

npcs.name: Toma
npcs.label: Talk to Toma
npcs.message: That puppy keeps popping up to greet everyone, and the cat pretends she is not watching. Your own companion is welcome too. A home and a little care can make even a restless creature feel safe.

npcs.name: Dockmaster
npcs.label: Talk to Dockmaster
npcs.message: The new fishing outfitter is open, and the path to Shadow Woods is clear. Bring your catches home. See that hammer mark by the quay? The old builders left us more than sturdy stone.

npcs.name: Innkeeper
npcs.label: Talk to the Innkeeper
npcs.message: The kettle is always on at Lantern Inn. Travelers bring stories from beyond the ridge, and we give them somewhere warm to share them. The lobby is open; overnight room booking will come later.
